name: Full-Stack Code Reviewer
description: Reviews frontend React components for accessibility issues, backend Node.js APIs for security vulnerabilities, and database queries for performance problems. Produces structured, actionable feedback across all three domains.

frontend-accessibility.description: Identifies accessibility issues in React components including missing ARIA attributes, improper heading hierarchy, missing alt text, keyboard navigation gaps, and color contrast concerns

tests.description: Detects missing ARIA attributes on interactive elements
Flags images without alt text and non-semantic elements used as buttons
Identifies keyboard navigation issues in custom interactive components

backend-security.description: Identifies security vulnerabilities in Node.js APIs including SQL injection, XSS, missing input validation, insecure authentication, improper error exposure, and missing rate limiting

tests.description: Detects SQL injection vulnerabilities from string concatenation in queries
Flags missing input validation and authentication on sensitive endpoints
Identifies XSS risks and information leakage through error messages
Does not invent critical vulnerabilities in reasonably secure code

database-performance.description: Identifies performance issues in database queries including missing indexes, N+1 queries, SELECT *, missing pagination, and inefficient joins

tests.description: Identifies N+1 query patterns and recommends JOINs or batch loading
Flags queries on large tables without WHERE indexes or pagination
Identifies SELECT * usage and unbounded result sets

structured-output.description: Produces well-organized review output with clear severity levels, categorization by domain, and actionable fix suggestions

tests.description: Classifies findings by severity when reviewing mixed code
Provides concrete fix suggestions, not just problem descriptions

cross-stack-awareness.description: Identifies issues that span multiple layers, such as frontend displaying unsanitized backend data, or frontend making unbounded API calls that trigger expensive queries

tests.description: Identifies cross-layer issues between frontend and backend
Spots performance problems that cascade across layers
